purpose: Bound the existing first-match cross-policy fully-shadowed cases; forbid unreviewed additions.

review_notes.AdBlock: Advertising and telemetry matches intentionally take priority over broader service roots, including some service-owned subdomains. Requires on-device validation for functionality.
review_notes.DIRECT: ChinaDirect is last and is never allowed to override earlier service/crypto rules. Its covered entries are redundant fallback input, not active DIRECT behavior.
review_notes.Google: YouTube-specific broad gvt1/gvt2 CDN ownership creates known overlaps with Google beacons. Keep current behavior pending app-level evidence; do not silently change shared CDN routing.
review_notes.Apple: Apple PCC specific Cloudflare hosts require Apple and AppleOTA *both* before generic Cloudflare remote subscription on the next pinned release.
review_notes.Exact duplicate: Two MDex entries occur in late ChinaDirect after Crypto; earlier Crypto has precedence. Review when replacing the enormous pinned ChinaDirect snapshot.

first_match: Report only deterministic hostname DOMAIN and DOMAIN-SUFFIX shadows. Separate reversed/partial overlaps, keyword, IP, GeoIP, client actual matches and observed outcomes.
